object_type.description: Discriminator so a downstream consumer (Part 2 loader) can tell table vs class objects apart without inspecting shape.

name.description: The AOT table name, e.g. VendTrans. Taken from the root <Name> tag.

xsi_type.description: The i:type attribute value, e.g. AxTableFieldString, AxTableFieldEnum.

edt.description: Value of <ExtendedDataType> if present, else null. NULL DOES NOT MEAN 'NO TYPE INFO' -- check enum_type before treating a field as untyped. Confirmed real case: VendTrans.TransType has edt=null.

enum_type.description: Value of <EnumType> if present, else null. Some enum fields carry both edt AND enum_type. Some carry ONLY enum_type.

constraints.description: A single relation's constraint list may mix constraint kinds in the same relation.

constraint.description: Three real constraint shapes confirmed across the 6-table fixture set.

kind.description: column_join = AxTableRelationConstraintField (source column joins target column). target_value = AxTableRelationConstraintRelatedFixed (target/related column pinned to a value or left implicit, no source Field tag at all). source_value = AxTableRelationConstraintFixed (source column pinned to a value, no RelatedField tag at all -- confirmed real case: PurchLine's ItemRefType discriminator constraints).

field.description: Source-side column name. Non-null when kind=column_join or kind=source_value. Always null when kind=target_value.

related_field.description: Target-side column name. Non-null when kind=column_join or kind=target_value. Always null when kind=source_value -- this is the shape that broke validation on 4 of 6 real fixtures before it was found.

value.description: Present when a <ValueStr> tag exists. Confirmed real case: SalesTable's PurchTable relation has kind=source_value with no ValueStr at all.
